correctness.rationale: The 35 possible weight-three words, 595 distinct-word pairs, and 630 forbidden four-word integer-sum collision constraints are regenerated without imported tables. The exact six-vertex C4-free link bound of 7 is independently exhaustively verified over 32768 graphs; the two-way inclusion/exclusion branching omits no feasible completion and proves no 15-word codebook exists (242909 states) and exactly 48 valid 14-word codebooks contain a fixed triple (432937 states). Every such optimum has double-Fano pair incidence. A 14-word cyclic witness is independently verified; the orbit has 120 codebooks, equal to 35*48/14. Both standalone verifier programs were compiled/executed successfully.

originality.rationale: The earliest relevant primary paper, Meszka–Rosa (2018), already proves the uniqueness and labeled count 120 of double Fano planes but does not assert their equivalence to optimal integer-sum B2 codebooks. Sima–Li–Shomorony–Milenkovic arXiv:2303.12990 (2023) defines constant-weight binary B2 sequences and studies broad bounds and constructions without the exact seven-coordinate weight-three optimum in inspected full text. published-finding corpus searches for B2, Sidon triples, 14, 120, double Fano and equivalent sum-language returned only non-implicative objects. The novel assertion is the exact optimal-B2/double-Fano correspondence, not the previously published design count. A same-result formulation in unindexed sources remains possible.
residual_risks: An unindexed B2 or 2-separable code table may independently identify the 7,3 optimum.
Full paper of Della Fiore and Dalai (2022) was not inspected; only its accessible abstract was read.
The 120 double Fano plane count and uniqueness are established earlier and are not novel independently.

value.rationale: The integer pair-sum uniqueness condition models recovery of two distinct sparse binary words from an additive observation. Seven coordinates and three markers are a natural incidence-design boundary, not an arbitrary normalization: the complete optimum is exactly a double Fano plane, with all 120 labeled optimal designs classified. This supplies exact capacity, constructions, symmetry and an exhaustive obstruction; merely reproving the known 120 design count is not presented as value.
